capabilities: Read EPUB books in paginated or scrolling mode with themes and font settings
Highlight text in five colors and add five types of margin notes
Export annotations as Markdown excerpt files with deep links back to the book
Browse all vault EPUBs in a cover-grid bookshelf with progress and finished marks
Auto-paste copied excerpts into a side-by-side Markdown note
disambiguation: Not a PDF or general document reader; it only opens .epub files and exports excerpts to Markdown.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; annotation and bookshelf feature groups can be disabled to keep a plain reading mode; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; licensed MIT.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .epub books or capture highlights and excerpts from them as linked Markdown notes.
summary: EPUB reader for Obsidian with TOC navigation, highlights and margin notes, Markdown excerpt export, and a bookshelf with reading progress.
